mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO message_sessions ( customer_id, agent_id, last_rental_id, created_at, updated_at )
VALUES ( #{customerId}, #{agentId}, #{rentalId}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_rental_id = #{rentalId}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.select:
SELECT ms.id AS sessionId,
COALESCE( ms.last_message_at, ms.created_at ) AS activityAt,
contact_user.id AS contactId, contact_user.nickname AS contactName,
COALESCE( contact_company.name, '' ) AS contactCompany,
avatar_file.storage_key AS avatarStorageKey,
r.id AS rentalId, r.name AS rentalName, image_file.storage_key AS imageStorageKey, r.floor_plan AS floorPlan, r.area_sqm AS area, r.monthly_rent AS monthlyRent,
lm.id AS lastMessageId, lm.sender_id AS lastSenderId, lm.text AS lastMessageText, lm.created_at AS lastMessageCreatedAt,
( SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM message_attachments ma
WHERE ma.message_id = lm.id ) AS lastImageCount,
( SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM messages unread_message
WHERE unread_message.session_id = ms.id
AND unread_message.sender_id <> #{userId}
AND unread_message.id > COALESCE( CASE WHEN ms.customer_id = #{userId} THEN ms.customer_last_read_message_id ELSE ms.agent_last_read_message_id END, 0 ) ) AS unreadCount
FROM message_sessions ms
INNER JOIN users contact_user ON contact_user.id = CASE WHEN ms.customer_id = #{userId} THEN ms.agent_id ELSE ms.customer_id END
LEFT JOIN companies contact_company ON contact_company.id = contact_user.company_id
LEFT JOIN files avatar_file ON avatar_file.id = contact_user.avatar_file_id AND avatar_file.owner_id = contact_user.id AND avatar_file.purpose = 'AVATAR' AND avatar_file.status = 1
LEFT JOIN rentals r ON r.id = ms.last_rental_id
LEFT JOIN files image_file ON image_file.id = ( SELECT ri.file_id
FROM rental_images ri
INNER JOIN files photo_file ON photo_file.id = ri.file_id AND photo_file.status = 1 AND photo_file.purpose = 'RENTAL_IMAGE'
WHERE ri.rental_id = r.id AND ri.kind = 'PHOTO'
ORDER BY ri.sort_order ASC, ri.id ASC
LIMIT 1 )
LEFT JOIN messages lm ON lm.id = ms.last_message_id AND lm.session_id = ms.id
WHERE ( ms.customer_id = #{userId} OR ms.agent_id = #{userId} )
AND ( COALESCE( ms.last_message_at, ms.created_at ) < #{beforeTime}
OR ( COALESCE( ms.last_message_at, ms.created_at ) = #{beforeTime}
AND ms.id < #{beforeId} ) )
ORDER BY COALESCE( ms.last_message_at, ms.created_at ) DESC,
ms.id DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
